biggest_catch: Dollar-for-dollar means you must save up to $300 of your own money each year to get the $300 — and the grant is first-come, first-served subject to availability of funds, so applying does not guarantee an award. Both you and the beneficiary must be Nevada residents with household income at or under $74,999.
catches: Dollar-for-dollar match on your own contributions: save $100, get $100; save $300+, get the full $300. It is a savings boost on planned college savings, not free money.
First-come, first-served and subject to availability of funds — there is 'no guarantee of the continued operation' of the program; qualifying and applying does not guarantee an award.
You must APPLY or RE-APPLY every year inside your Future Path 529 account — the link opens April 1 and closes July 31; miss the window and that year's match is gone.
Residency + income + age gates: both owner and beneficiary must be Nevada residents, household income $74,999 or less, beneficiary age 13 or younger as of Dec 31 of the first application year.
You must already have a Future Path 529 account — the grant cannot be the reason to open one from scratch (it can, actually, but the account must exist at application).
Matching funds are deposited the following January — roughly a year after you start saving for that year's match.
Lifetime maximum $1,500 per beneficiary over five years — one application per beneficiary per year.
Standard 529 tax risk: non-qualified withdrawals face federal income tax plus a 10% federal penalty on earnings (and possible state tax consequences) — consult a tax professional.

steps: Open or keep a Future Path 529 Plan account with a beneficiary age 13 or younger (as of Dec 31 of the first application year).
Between April 1 and July 31, log into FuturePath529.com, open the beneficiary's account, and click 'Apply / Re-Apply for the Silver State Matching Grant' — repeat every year.
Save during the calendar year (January 1–December 31) — up to $300 of your contributions earns the full $300 match.
The matching grant is deposited into the beneficiary's account the following January.
timing: Annual cycle: apply April 1–July 31; contributions during the calendar year; match deposited the following January; up to 5 years / $1,500 lifetime per beneficiary.
